        adj[a].emplace_back(edges.size());
        edges.emplace_back(b, 0, cap, cost, cost);
        adj[b].emplace_back(edges.size());
        edges.emplace_back(a, 0, 0, -cost, -cost);
        return result;
    }

        };

                    states[ed.u].prev = edid;
